kept.snippet: The measurement feature requires both a TPM and an independent verifier. Measurement is similar to the pre-OS trusted boot concept. The first measurement is the boot aggregate, which is a hash of TPM PCR 0-9. IMA keeps a table of the measured hash values. If the hash is seen again, the contents are not re-measured again.
